hypothesis.legacy_metric: NS noise_rms_dbfs averages half-spectrum FFT-bin noise power and divides by nfft^2, so it is not directly comparable to time-domain frame RMS.
hypothesis.scale_model: For stationary input with the existing symmetric sine analysis window, reconstructing full-spectrum power and undoing window/zero-padding energy yields a deterministic multiplicative factor 2*bins*nfft/frame_samples.
hypothesis.future_use_under_review: A calibrated pre-suppression NS noise reference may support a same-domain local SNR cue without routing VAD wholesale to the pre-NS waveform.

next_review: Only a supported scale model may justify a separately preregistered candidate-zero same-domain SNR feasibility study. This investigation itself cannot select or authorize a source candidate.
